notes: This is one additive resource family; private GHC, Cabal and Hackage inputs do not add resource identities.
Source artifacts contain the exact primary archive once and the complete private build/replay raw inputs once in recipe/inputs. Deployment uses no package index or download.

A source installation builds Megaparsec and the frontend using its independent configured GHC bindist, Cabal project/store and source copies. PackageManager retains this development operation after install/remove.

Use compile_client.py with an explicit source operation build directory to compile a new grammar importing Text.Megaparsec. The source operation must still exist; reconstruct it from the source artifact if it was deliberately cleaned.

A binary artifact supports the bounded cpg-let-v1 frontend plus source/reference material. It does not install or relocate a GHC package database and does not automatically reuse another environment's source build.
The full upstream test suite has a separate offline replay entry. Ordinary source deployment runs frontend checks but does not assert that the upstream suite was rerun.
GHC/Cabal are official prebuilt build tools. Native host prerequisites are recorded explicitly; the source artifact is not an OS image or a complete OS dependency closure.
Target distribution/version describe the reference build. Actual OS/architecture and runtime checks decide installation; no distribution-name allowlist is introduced.
Historical paths in retained build evidence are provenance. Installed commands and materials use the selected prefix; no current functionality is inferred from an old log.
